note: derivatives, adjacent poles point adj_up set micro

quantities.derivative: d_<name> at a time is the partial derivative of the concentration with respect to the parameter <name> of this case (the dose fixed; for the macro set vc = D / (a + b + c) moves with a, b and c); 0 before the dose and before the lag; d_tlag is not written at the kinks t = tlag and t = tlag + dur, d_dur not at t = tlag + dur (the derivative has a jump there)
quantities.omitted: an entry whose condition number (sum of the absolute terms of the chain rule through V, the three exponents and two weights, divided by the absolute sum; for ka, tlag, dur a derivative below 1e-12 of the concentration per unit of the parameter) exceeds 1e3 is not written: no closed form in double precision can be asked for 1e-12 relative accuracy there

method.derivatives: central differences in 256-bit arithmetic (Rmpfr), relative step 1e-25, of the independent explicit form of the concentration, the roots of every perturbed parameter set re-solved; chain rule through psi = (V, alpha, beta, gamma, w_alpha, w_beta); rounded once to double
